stage: After the initial pilot and three-instance execution, before manuscript inclusion
change: Add stat-based aliases as an established, stronger identity baseline. Replace each path by the (device,inode) of the file it currently names before assigning a PATH alias.
reason: Path.resolve does not identify hard links. Comparing only against that baseline could misleadingly imply that extra receipt fields are necessary. Direct object-based normalization may perform just as well in an unchanged filesystem.
interpretation: Both stat-based aliases and added identity receipts consult information absent from ordinary raw logs. Neither is a privacy-filter-only repair for missing evidence. No race or persistent-identity guarantee is tested.
